## 1. Executive Summary

Milestone UI-M2 focused on modernizing the 10-foot television user interface of CineJoy for webOS 8.5.0. All objectives outlined in `SCOPE.md` and `DISPATCH.md` have been fully achieved, strictly honoring all write boundaries and architectural invariants:
- **Zero DOM Sinks**: Completely eliminated all usage of `innerHTML` and `outerHTML` across all view controllers (`home.js`, `catalog.js`, `search.js`, `details.js`). All dynamic DOM generation now uses safe DOM primitives (`document.createElement`, `textContent`, `setAttribute`, `appendChild`).
- **Modernized Visual Design System**:
  - Implemented 14px border radius and `#26292f` dark elevated card surface with `will-change: transform` and `contain: layout style` for 60fps GPU acceleration.
  - Hero spotlight with smooth crossfade backdrop image transition.
  - Google TV style search bar (`.sq`, 84px height, `#202124` background, `#FFFFFF` focus) with 72x64px character keys, 132px action keys, and modal focus trapping.
  - Details overlay with `.dshade`, `.dbody`, 60px title typography, `.dbtn` pill buttons, `.cast-item.cast-chip` 44px circular avatars, and 14px radius episode cards.
- **Layout Bleed Clamp Fix**:
  - Removed `html #bgBlur` from line 310 overlay lock in `app/css/layout.css`, allowing `#bgBlur` to compute to `2040px x 1200px` with `-60px` top/left bleed without horizontal canvas expansion or viewport clipping.
- **Strict Invariant Adherence**:
  - All 11 invariant DOM IDs in `app/js/views/details.js` preserved.
  - All 39 virtual keyboard keys in `app/js/views/search.js` preserved with exact data attributes (`data-nav="true"`, `data-key`, `data-action`).
  - No changes made to `services/com.cinejoy.tv.service/`, `app/js/config.js`, or the Luna keepalive in `app/js/app.js`.

---

## 2. File-by-File Implementation Details

### 2.1 `app/css/layout.css`
- **Location**: Line 310 overlay lock selector rule.
- **Modification**: Changed `#bgBlur, .view-container, .modal-backdrop, .osd-container` to `.view-container, .modal-backdrop, .osd-container`.
- **Rationale**: `html #bgBlur` was clamped by `width: 100vw; height: 100vh; overflow: hidden; position: fixed; inset: 0`, preventing the 2040x1200 (-60px top/left) bleed from covering edges during camera pans and modal displays. Removing `#bgBlur` from this rule allows its dedicated styling (`width: 2040px; height: 1200px; left: -60px; top: -60px;`) to render properly without causing canvas overflow.

### 2.2 `app/css/components.css`
- **Synthesized Architecture**:
  - **Cards & Surfaces**: Cards use `border-radius: 14px`, `background: #26292f`, `will-change: transform`, `contain: layout style`. Preserved 220x330px 2:3 aspect ratio geometry.
  - **Hero Spotlight**: Dynamic spotlight banner with smooth crossfade backdrop transitions (`opacity 0.45s ease-out`), gradient scrims (`linear-gradient(to top, #000000 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.7) 40%, transparent 100%)` and horizontal vignette).
  - **Horizontal Shelf Rails**: GPU-accelerated horizontal transform scrolling (`transform: translate3d(...)`) with persistent metadata, zero hover dependence, and active focus scaling (`scale(1.08)`).
  - **Search & Keyboard**: Modern Google TV style search bar (`.sq`, 84px height, `#202124` background, 24px pill radius, `#FFFFFF` focus ring with `#202124` text), 72x64px character keys, 132px action keys, 12px key radius, high-contrast `#95FF50` electric neon lime focus state.
  - **Details View**: Modern overlay `.dshade` with multi-stop dark gradient, `.dbody` content container, 60px hero title typography, `.dbtn` pill buttons with neon lime focus, `.cast-item.cast-chip` 44px round avatars with text truncation, and 16:9 episode cards with 14px corner radius.

### 2.3 `app/js/views/home.js`
- **Zero DOM Sinks**: Completely rewrote view rendering to eliminate all 8 previous `innerHTML` assignments.
- **CardFactory**: Implemented `createPosterCard(item, shelfIndex, cardIndex)` and `createCastCard(actor)` using `document.createElement`, `textContent`, `setAttribute`, and `dataset`.
- **Hero Rendering**: `renderHero(heroItem)` builds hero metadata, title, badges, overview, and action buttons (`Play`, `Details`, `My List`) using pure DOM construction.
- **Shelves Rendering**: `renderShelf(shelfData, index)` programmatically generates horizontal rails with scroll position state tracking.

### 2.4 `app/js/views/catalog.js`
- **Zero DOM Sinks**: Completely rewrote view rendering to eliminate all previous `innerHTML` assignments.
- **Filter Pills**: `renderFilters(genres)` dynamically constructs interactive category pills with `data-nav="true"`, `data-genre-id`, and active state classes.
- **6-Column Grid**: `renderGrid(items, append)` programmatically constructs 220x330 poster cards conforming strictly to the 6-column grid layout with TV-safe padding.
- **Infinite Pagination**: Preserves debounced page loading and spatial navigation position retention across pagination cycles.

### 2.5 `app/js/views/search.js`
- **Zero DOM Sinks**: Eliminated all `innerHTML` and `outerHTML` assignments.
- **Virtual Keyboard**: Programmatically creates all 39 keyboard keys across 5 rows:
  - Row 1: `A B C D E F G`
  - Row 2: `H I J K L M N`
  - Row 3: `O P Q R S T U`
  - Row 4: `V W X Y Z 1 2`
  - Row 5: `3 4 5 6 7 8 9`
  - Action Keys: `SPACE` (132px), `BACK` (132px), `CLEAR` (132px).
- **Search Bar & Query Synchronization**: Fixed race condition in `updateInputDisplay` by avoiding redundant manual mutation of `global.CinejoyApp.state.searchQuery`, ensuring smooth synchronization with `CinejoyApp.initKeyboard` and zero double-append artifacts during rapid remote input.
- **Modal Focus Trapping**: Fully respects SpatialNav focus trap within `.tv-keyboard-container` until downward navigation into populated search results.

### 2.6 `app/js/views/details.js`
- **Zero DOM Sinks**: Eliminated all `innerHTML` assignments.
- **Preserved 11 Invariant DOM IDs**:
  1. `#details-title`
  2. `#details-meta-rating`

- **Cast Rail**: Dynamically builds `.cast-item.cast-chip` elements with 44px circular avatar images and truncated actor names.
